newsitem.title: USA: Goulds Pumps stake upped by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: Goulds Pumps stake upped by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Wednesday it raised its stake in Goulds Pumps to 3,464,432 common shares or 16.25 percent from 15.06 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 262,500 common shares bought between January 17 and February 13 at prices ranging from $22.2596 to $24.7736 per share.
Goulds, based in Seneca Falls, New York, is engaged in designing, manufacturing and servicing of pumps, motors and accessories for industrial, agricultural, commercial and consumer markets.
